blocks.text: LUCENA CITY—Policemen arrested two drug convicts who yielded more than P159,000 worth of suspected shabu (crystal meth) in separate buy-bust operations in Lucena City on Saturday, Oct. 10. A member of the city police drug enforcement unit, posing as a drug user, arrested a 31-year-old suspect at 1:03 p.m. after he allegedly sold the operative a pack of shabu in Barangay Ibabang Iyam, Lucena City police chief Lt. Col. Ryan Hernandez said in a report on Sunday. The operative seized three heat-sealed plastic sachets containing suspected shabu worth P77,520 from the suspect.
